title: Transformer模型在文本摘要中的比较研究：BART、BERT与RoBERTa
summary: 本文聚焦于基于Transformer和大型语言模型的现代文本摘要技术，重点比较BERT、RoBERTa和BART的架构、预训练策略及其在抽取式和生成式摘要任务中的适用性。
summary_en: This article reviews modern text summarization techniques, focusing on transformer-based models and LLMs, specifically BERT, RoBERTa, and BART, examining their architectures, pretraining strategies, and suitability for extractive and abstractive summarization.
